title: 3rd IMDC 2026 Dengue Forecasts
text:
This report summarizes the BSC-GHR legacy dengue model used for the 3rd IMDC 2026 forecasting challenge. It brings the validation and production rounds into one report, with observed cases where available, predictive medians, and posterior predictive uncertainty intervals.






NoteCountry-wide aggregation



The country-wide series is the sum of the 26 federative units included in the submitted model. Espírito Santo (UF 32) is not included, so the country-wide figures should be interpreted as the aggregate of the modelled units rather than a complete Brazil total.


The production forecast covers 52 weeks, from 11 October 2026 to 03 October 2027, with 1000 posterior predictive draws per state-week. The submitted model is tied to Git commit b3af423fbf2f714612e6b8d4061daafa5bfda83c.




Show code
validation_rounds |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    split = paste("Split", .split_id),
    start = format(start, "%Y-%m-%d"),
    end = format(end, "%Y-%m-%d")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(split, start, end, weeks) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    split = "Validation round",
    start = "Start",
    end = "End",
    weeks = "Weeks"
  ) |>
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::pct(75))

title: 3rd IMDC 2026 Dengue Forecasts
text:
Predictive performance
The table reports point accuracy for the predictive median and empirical coverage of the predictive intervals. Country-week metrics evaluate the aggregate of the modelled units; state-week metrics pool all state-week observations within each validation round.


Show code
metrics |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    split = paste("Split", .split_id),
    mae = round(mae, 1),
    rmse = round(rmse, 1),
    dplyr::across(dplyr::starts_with("coverage_"), ~ round(100 * .x, 1))
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    split, level, n, mae, rmse,
    coverage_50, coverage_80, coverage_90, coverage_95
  ) |>
  gt::gt(groupname_col = "split") |>
  gt::cols_label(
    level = "Level",
    n = "N",
    mae = "MAE",
    rmse = "RMSE",
    coverage_50 = "50% coverage",
    coverage_80 = "80% coverage",
    coverage_90 = "90% coverage",
    coverage_95 = "95% coverage"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(mae, rmse), decimals = 1) |>
  gt::fmt_number(
    columns = dplyr::starts_with("coverage_"),
    decimals = 1,
    pattern = "{x}%"
  )

section: Total cases over each validation horizon
text:
Total cases over each validation horizon
The table compares observed and predicted total cases over each validation horizon. Predictive intervals are calculated by summing the posterior predictive draws across all modelled health regions and weeks before taking quantiles.


Show code
validation_country_totals |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    split = paste("Split", .split_id),
    observed = round(cases),
    median = round(pred),
    interval_95 = paste0(
      scales::comma(round(lower_95)),
      " – ",
      scales::comma(round(upper_95))
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(split, observed, median, interval_95) |>
  gt::gt() |>
  gt::cols_label(
    split = "Validation round",
    observed = "Observed cases",
    median = "Predicted median",
    interval_95 = "95% predictive interval"
  ) |>
  gt::fmt_number(columns = c(observed, median), decimals = 0, use_seps = TRUE)

Country-wide forecast


Show code

  production_country,
  observed = FALSE,
  title = "Country-wide production forecast",
  subtitle = "Aggregate of the 26 modelled federative units"
)









Across the full forecast horizon, the model projects a median of 1,804,442 cases, with a 95% posterior predictive interval of 755,475–4,231,617 cases, for the 26 modelled units combined.

title: 3rd IMDC 2026 Dengue Forecasts
text:
Projected burden by state
This figure summarizes total cases over the full forecast horizon. The intervals are again calculated from draw-by-draw sums across weeks.


Show code
production_state_totals |>
  dplyr::mutate(uf = forcats::fct_reorder(uf, pred)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = uf, y = pred)) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = lower_95, ymax = upper_95),
    linewidth = 0.45,
    colour = "#93C5FD"
  ) +
  geom_linerange(
    aes(ymin = lower_50, ymax = upper_50),
    linewidth = 2.2,
    colour = "#3B82F6"
  ) +
  geom_point(size = 2, colour = "#1D4ED8") +
  coord_flip() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::label_comma()) +
  labs(
    title = "Projected dengue cases over the forecast horizon",
    subtitle = "Point: median; thick line: 50% interval; thin line: 95% interval",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Total forecast cases"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
